requested_outcome: A production-safe VII candidate that closes the catalog outage and is ready for the later primary-domain cutover.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co and its public catalog endpoints
authorization_boundary: Application code, tests, source push and production publication are authorized. DNS, custom domains, supplier data, secrets, schedules and permissions remain unchanged.

predicted_rejections.prevention: Fall through to the already accepted bundled snapshot and retain strict projection.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Database-failure test and live SPA catalog both return validated non-empty HTTP 200 responses.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The temporary host works but the primary origin later emits wrong canonical URLs.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep host-aware worker rewriting and run the primary-origin and launch SEO suites.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: All origin stream and launch SEO tests pass.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A release is claimed from the wrong source or an uncertain duplicate publish.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Record exact source commit and tree before one publication, then wait for a terminal result.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: One terminal deployment maps to the tested commit and rollback identity.

midpoint_gate: Focused catalog and origin tests pass with the intended diff only.
adversarial_close: Inspect the exact deployed candidate, all four catalogs, sitemap, robots, llms and representative public routes.
